source.census_access: public ACS 2024 5-year table-based summary file; CENSUS_API_KEY was not set

acs.geography: Census tracts in Cook County IL (17031) and Philadelphia County PA (42101). Philadelphia County is the city. Cook County is wider than Chicago; a point uses centroids within 1.2 km only.

source.unassigned_bin: B19001_E012 ($60,000 to $74,999) crosses the CEX $70,000 boundary and is excluded from spend.
source.assumption: One ACS household is treated as one CEX consumer unit. No discounting.
